tapeLine: Thursday 12 November: S&P 500 −0.4% (−26.98) to 7,592.40; Dow −0.4% (−189.40) to 52,297.09; Nasdaq Composite −0.39% (−100.10) to 25,366.09, per close reports dated 12 Nov. Russell 2000 is not carried: one wire showed +1.6%, two recaps showed −1.66%.
matters:
Nvidia announced Thursday that Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO while remaining CFO; the board has opened a search for a permanent successor (Nvidia 8-K). The stock fell more than 13% early in the session and closed −4.34% at $166.19, per Benzinga; the S&P 500, which was down nearly 1% at the open, finished −0.4%.

Today brings October PPI at 08:30 ET, with a Dow Jones consensus of +6.6% year over year, which would be the largest annual rise since November 2022, against 6.3% in September. Futures were little changed early Friday. Nvidia reports third-quarter earnings Tuesday 17 Nov with an interim CEO.

calendar.consensus: +0.4% m/m; +6.6% y/y (Dow Jones consensus via Stocktitan; Investing.com same y/y)

alsoOnTape: Brent crude futures −0.21% to $95.64 and WTI −0.59% to $88.18 early Friday, per TipRanks 13 Nov. The 10-year Treasury yield briefly topped 5% on Tuesday 10 Nov after CPI (MarketWatch, 10 Nov); no clean dated close for Thursday was found and none is carried. Gold and VIX levels were not found with a clean dated source.
overnight: Latest confirmed close — Thursday 12 November: S&P 500 7,592.40 (−0.4%); Nasdaq Composite 25,366.09 (−0.39%); Dow 52,297.09 (−0.4%).
Futures — early Friday snapshots: Dow +0.2%, S&P 500 +0.1%, Nasdaq-100 near flat (Yahoo Finance); TipRanks had Nasdaq-100 −0.13%, S&P +0.12%, Dow +0.21%.

Nvidia — rose 0.99% after hours Thursday to $167.84 following the resignation announcement, per Benzinga. Further reports emerged of a third alleged affair (Yahoo Finance live coverage), and CNN reports Huang has been summoned to testify before Congress.
macro: Jobless claims — initial claims rose 9,000 to 200,000 in the week ending 7 Nov, above the 195,000 consensus; prior revised to 191,000 from 189,000; four-week average 195,250 (Labor Department via Reuters/AP, 12 Nov). Continuing claims 1.697 million for the week ending 31 Oct.
Nvidia succession — 8-K says Kress is interim CEO and CFO; the board will consider internal and external candidates. Earnings remain scheduled for Tuesday 17 Nov.

Rates backdrop — October CPI (+0.4% m/m headline, +0.3% core, BLS 10 Nov) prompted talk of a larger Fed move, per Seoul Economic Daily coverage dated 12 Nov; no Fed official statement is carried here.
flow: Breadth, dealer gamma, put-call and skew are paid data and are not on this page.

regime.tag: Index absorbed the Nvidia CEO exit with a modest loss; wholesale inflation is today’s macro test.
regime.sizing: A 6.6% y/y PPI consensus after a hot CPI keeps rates in focus; how a reading above or below that lands is unresolved.

secondOrder: Nvidia went from −13% intraday to −4.3% at the close and slightly higher after hours, so the S&P 500 finished well off its opening low. The governance shock arrives four days before earnings, which now come without the founder as CEO. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: The prior brief said the bond market was closed for Veterans Day so there had been no Treasury reaction to October CPI, and that Thursday was the first bond session since CPI. Wrong: CPI was released Tuesday 10 Nov while bonds were trading, and the 10-year yield rose about 12 bp and briefly topped 5% that day (MarketWatch, 10 Nov).
The prior brief listed jobless-claims consensus at 195K with a 189K prior. The print was 200K against a 195K consensus, and the prior was revised to 191K; the listing itself was accurate.

The prior brief said how much of Wednesday’s Nasdaq gain would survive Nvidia’s premarket drop was unresolved. The Nasdaq fell 0.39% Thursday after a +1.6% Wednesday. No direction was called, so there is nothing to grade right or wrong.
